newsitem.title: CHINA: China closes Xinjiang petrochemical plant.
newsitem.headline: China closes Xinjiang petrochemical plant.

text.p: China has shut a small petrochemical plant in northwestern Xinjiang due to financial losses and pollution problems, the China News Service said on Wednesday.
It said the Karamay Oilfield Administration and the local government had shut the plant, which had been producing caustic soda as well as sealants and chemicals used in oil recovery operations.
The plant, built at a cost of more than 100 million yuan ($12 million) and in operation since 1989, had limited output and was unable to reach efficient production levels.
It had lost money for several years and had a deficit of more than 30 million yuan in 1996 alone, the news service said.
The plant also had no waste water treatment facilities.
About 200 plant employees had been trained for other jobs, the news service said without giving further details.
